correctness.rationale: The affine change \(X=x+\beta/\alpha\) transforms the first trace equation to the second with \(\gamma'=\gamma+\operatorname{Tr}(\beta/\alpha)\), and the accompanying parameter change \(c'=c-\operatorname{Tr}(a\beta/\alpha)\) preserves codeword coordinates, proving permutation equivalence. For each nonzero \(b\), the relevant trace map in \(a\) is a surjective \(\mathbb F_p\)-linear functional with fibers of size \(p^{m-1}\), while \(c\) makes the other scalar uniform. Independently recounting the discriminant classes gives \(p-1\) zero, \((p-1)(p-2)/2\) nonzero-square, and \(p(p-1)/2\) nonsquare cases, yielding the displayed frequencies. Independent MacWilliams calculations for \((p,m)=(3,2),(5,2),(3,3)\) gave dual coefficients \((1,0,0,A_3^\perp)\) with the claimed positive formula. The four weights order with \(w_3\) minimal, and subtraction gives the claimed correction. The frozen direct GF(9)/GF(25) verifier and certificate were also read in full.

final_claim: Under the nondegenerate hypotheses of Theorems III.2 and III.5 of Huang--Liang--Jia--Wan--Liao, the two augmented defining-set codes are permutation equivalent, share the stated four-weight enumerator, are projective with dual distance exactly \(3\), and have minimum distance \(p^{m-1}(p^m-p^{m-1}-2)\), correcting the smaller expression printed in Theorem III.5.
